items.a: TENET is an AI aggregation platform. Through one unified OpenAI-compatible API, you get access to mainstream models like ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek. No need to integrate each vendor separately or manage multiple keys - one interface covers them all, with stable routing, transparent billing and data protection.

We currently support OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1), Anthropic (Claude 3.7, 3.5) and DeepSeek (V3, R1), and keep adding more. Every model is served through the same OpenAI-compatible API, so switching models is just changing one parameter - no code changes needed.

It takes just three steps: 1) Sign up in the console, ready in a minute; 2) Create a dedicated API key for secure access to all models; 3) Make your first request with the OpenAI-compatible API. No expert skills needed - get it running in minutes, live today.
You pay for actual usage with fully transparent bills. No subscriptions, no monthly lock-in. New users get trial credits on signup; balance and usage are always visible, top up anytime.
